issue_request: FHIR-8626 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core Provenance issue reporting that the build had stopped expanding the v3 Value Set ProvenanceEventCurrentState.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 6659, which is git commit f39b36fce30962197cecb4d73ee5bf9e3552cdec titled '#8626 - fix expansion sub-system'. That commit changed the old Java value-set expansion subsystem and v3 value-set rendering/caching rather than adding a current Provenance resource source edit.
additional_context: The old Java publisher code is no longer present in this source checkout. Current v3 terminology input still defines ProvenanceEventCurrentState and its AS/DC component value sets in tools/tx/v3/source.xml, and tools/tx/v3/valuesets.ini selects all three. Later Published issue FHIR-10382 changed the Provenance.activity binding away from the old v3 state value set; current Provenance.activity binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/provenance-activity-type, sourced from source/terminologies/valueset-provenance-activity-type.xml.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical build-system fix was applied in r6659, the relevant v3 terminology source remains present, and the current Provenance resource no longer depends on v3-ProvenanceEventCurrentState for its activity binding.
